texts: good. the moon's fullness is recorded as a dated state with its plain 'the moon was full' half and past tense, and both date figures are kept. One caveat on our side: 'day 365' is stored in our calendar day-of-month term, so a day-of-year reading cannot be told apart from a day-of-month one — no rewrite fixes that, it is a gap in our time vocabulary.
good. the convening, the Council as a single collective actor, the Watch as the place and the past tense all come through, and neither capitalized common noun is mistaken for a proper name.

bad: the three-word compound 'bright-station proposal' is unpacked two levels deep, so the parse asserts facts about a 'bright station' kind that nothing in the passage actually is — only one level of unpacking is licensed, and the extra atoms are free-floating noise a reasoner can act on. Old Vesh's authorship of the proposal and the acceptance itself are recorded correctly. Rewrite as: 'The Council accepted Old Vesh's proposal for bright stations.' — with the inner compound out of the head noun, 'station' and 'bright' become licensed facts about a referent the sentence really introduces.

mixed: the issuing, the recipients, the 'extra' spread over each ration and the purpose link are all right, but three noun phrases go wrong — 'mire-essence rations' is unpacked a second level into atoms about mire-essence (only the 'rations' genus is licensed), 'three stations of the Middle Row' has no licensed link from a counted group to a named whole so the parse improvises a part-of, and the plural 'crowds' silently collapses to a single crowd because a set of groups has no representable form at all. Rewrite as: 'The Council issued extra rations of mire-essence to three stations in the Middle Row in order to draw a crowd of nightmoths to each station.'

good. the second purpose clause correctly hangs off the same issuing event as the previous sentence, and the sky-cats' continued hunting on the Cliff Path is recorded as the state the issuing was meant to maintain. 'Keep X V-ing' has no exact shape in our instruction set yet, but what the parse improvised here is faithful, so nothing needs rewriting.
